question: Does the Gateway owner approve this broad lifecycle-module split after the pending topology, build, lint, compact-test, and QA checks finish, with confidence that startup, reload, and shutdown ordering remains unchanged?
rationale: The `maintainer` label and the PR's cross-phase lifecycle scope make this an owner-bound refactor decision rather than a safe automatic merge or repair action.

options.title: Approve after lifecycle evidence
options.body: Review the extracted phase boundaries and land only when the pending checks are green and the owner accepts the startup/reload/shutdown preservation evidence.

options.title: Request live lifecycle proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Gateway startup, plugin reload, and close transcript or logs before deciding if test evidence alone is not sufficient for this refactor.

options.title: Narrow the refactor
options.body: Split the change into smaller lifecycle phases if the current review surface is too large to validate safely in one PR.

recommendation.title: Approve after lifecycle evidence
recommendation.body: Review the extracted phase boundaries and land only when the pending checks are green and the owner accepts the startup/reload/shutdown preservation evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR context names steipete as assignee and sole author of the current Gateway lifecycle split.
